description: This file defines the class VtigerCRMActorMeta, which extends EntityMeta and manages metadata for a CRM actor entity, including database interactions, field type mappings, permissions, and entity-specific logic within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: VtigerCRMActorMeta
classes.description: A class extending EntityMeta that provides metadata management and database interaction functionalities specific to CRM Actor entities within vtiger system.

methods.name: VtigerCRMActorMeta
methods.description: Constructor initializes the metadata object with database connection and table information, setting up field lists and primary key.

methods.name: getTableFieldList
methods.description: Fetches and constructs a list of WebserviceField objects representing the fields of the specified table.

methods.name: getFieldArrayFromDBField
methods.description: Creates an array of field properties from database field info suitable for WebserviceField objects.

methods.name: getReferenceList
methods.description: Retrieves reference types for a reference-type database field.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Obtains the field type from the database, utilizing cached mapping.

methods.name: getTypeOfDataForType
methods.description: Maps database data types to internal field type representations.

methods.name: getFieldDataTypeFromDBType
methods.description: Maps database data types to standard data types recognized by the application.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Determines if the current user has permission to perform a specific operation.

methods.name: hasAssignPrivilege
methods.description: Checks if the user has privilege to assign this entity to others.

methods.name: hasDeleteAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user can delete the entity.

methods.name: hasAccess
methods.description: General access check, currently always returns true.

methods.name: hasReadAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has read access to the entity, always returns true.

methods.name: hasWriteAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has write (edit) access.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the entity.

methods.name: getObjectEntityName
methods.description: Returns the entity name if a record exists.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether a record with a given ID exists in the base table.

methods.name: getNameFields
methods.description: Returns the name fields of the entity for display purposes.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Fetches the display name of the entity given its Webservice ID.

methods.name: getEntityAccessControlQuery
methods.description: Returns access control query string.

methods.name: getEntityDeletedQuery
methods.description: Returns the query string to check if an entity record is marked as deleted.

methods.name: isModuleEntity
methods.description: Indicates whether this entity is a module entity, always returns false.
